notes.title: Update 1.0.10
notes.content:
The [i]Street Cleaner: The Video Game[/i] arcade cabinet has been a huge hit at live events, and we're bringing this feature to everyone so you can make your own Street Cleaner arcade experience!

Enabling Arcade Mode is a two step process:
[h2]1) Set up Arcade options[/h2]

To set up arcade options, launch the game with the "-arcade-config" switch (as seen below).
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/7ab377c4cb1c49d2cec48059928c01996e744d3c.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/cac3513689710b6a1aee6b1e1fc16d5504a95072.jpg[/img][/url]

The menu will no include "ARCADE OPTIONS".
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/8d0f2648db44922de36aa35a32011208cae8e7d2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/3fa0bcbe3545bf36cf18350fdb3e95c3c80c6074.jpg[/img][/url]


Here, you can rebind they keyboard bindings for menu controls.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/76dac274a4286794dae7e03324371ca7282c27f1.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/5ece46bc2391c16812ef5f8b2026e1011bf494bd.jpg[/img][/url]

Additionally, set the "COIN" entry to the input sent by the coin slot of your cabinet.
(Be careful! If you bind these keys in a way that makes it impossible to navigate menus, you can fix them by editing or deleting the config file in ~/AppData/Roaming/CreakyLantern/SCTVG/options.txt)

You can also set the following options:
Lives/Cred.: How many lives are given per credit inserted to play.
Timeout: If set to YES, if no input is detected during gameplay for 3 minutes, the game will return to the main menu.


[h2]2) Launch in Arcade mode[/h2]

To run in Arcade mode, launch the game with the "-arcade" switch (as seen below).
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/6d392b732354fc76886953ad096a2a52f01e7ada.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/73bcb78244c40141aa6e573cb40f718d83f7cc61.jpg[/img][/url]


Arcade mode requires insertion of credits to play. If you unlock/have unlocked the Music Test, that will be available here as well.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/8146058961945ec14b65e021744b09c3290b79f0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/e9420e85993d69f6db3d4fee18b23eb6a6fffc74.jpg[/img][/url]

The game now plays using credits and lives. When you run out of lives you can insert a new credit to get more lives and continue playing, or you will return to the main menu.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/46dc9857772a988b2931abd039cb5dc96c5f358d.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37388022/ac37931cfa64e0e50e5174ffeefd328c9964db1a.jpg[/img][/url]

Enjoy!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Arcade style options to the game.
[*] Fixed a bug with backtracking into boss rooms that could result in clipping through floors.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added an analog stick dead zone setting to the options.
The default was, and remains 30%. If you find the stick on your controller is too sensitive, try increasing the dead zone value.
[/list]

tags.feature: Added an analog stick dead zone setting to the options.

notes.title: Update 1.0.7
notes.content:
* Fixed in game and end game timing to display milliseconds with 3 digits, to better match leaderboard displays.
* Added a "-glmodern" command line options. By default the game uses the OpenGL 3.2 CORE profile for wide-ranging compatibility with older video cards. Use this command line switch if you are having OpenGL display issues.
* Added a "-fullvsync" command line option. This alters the game to use standard vertical synchronization instead of "swap control tear" synchronization. Use this command line switch if you are having problems recording or streaming the game.
* Added new unlockable game mode. Can you solve the puzzle and unlock Highland?

notes.title: Update 1.0.6
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added a slight grace period to the down input to perform a dive kick.
Previously, kick input required strictly holding down, then pressing attack to perform. Now, attack can be pressed within a 6 frame window of releasing down while in the air to still perform a kick.
[*] Added more granular damage options to Assist mode to allow players to set a custom difficulty while playing. Options are now Normal (just like the normal game), Invincible (take no damage), Hardcore (single hit kills as in Hardcore mode), and 1, 2, 3, 4,  or 6. Where the numbered options denote how many pips of health are used when taking damage.
[/list]
